task_description.overview: Compute the b-value of the Gutenberg-Richter frequency-magnitude distribution using the maximum likelihood method.
steps: Ensure Catalog.mc and Catalog.delta_m are defined.
Call cat.estimate_b() to compute the b-value using internal properties.
Optionally, provide delta_m and mc as arguments to cat.estimate_b().
Alternatively, call the standalone function estimate_b(magnitudes, delta_m, mc) with a numpy array of magnitudes.
Extract the b-value from cat.b_value or the function return.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Estimate the b-value for the given catalog: {catalog_path}. Loading the catalog, and then estimate the b-value using `cat.estimate_b(delta_m={delta_m}, mc={mc})`. 
 Note: 1) Save the b-value data to {result_data.save name} with content {result_data.content}.
